# AiQueryInput

```ts
import { AiQueryInput } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The prompt input for hello pc AI experiences. A multiline field sits above a toolbar: an add action on the left, a mode toggle (voice by default) and the send button on the right. The segment (consumer, commercial, internal) tints the gradient ring, caret and send fill. Use it wherever a user writes a prompt to an assistant; for ordinary form text use TextInput.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `segment` | `AiSegment` | `'consumer'` | AI segment (Figma "Segment") — sets the gradient ring, caret, and the send-button fill from the --color-ai-<segment>-* tokens. |
| `status` | `'idle' \| 'sending' \| 'error'` | `'idle'` | Request lifecycle: idle, sending (send → Stop), error (error ring, inline message, send → Retry). Empty vs Typing is derived from the text. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled text. Pair with onValueChange. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | Uncontrolled initial text. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called on every edit with the new text. |
| `onSubmit` | `(value: string, meta: { contexts: string[] }) => void` | — | Called with the trimmed prompt (and the attached context values) when the user presses Enter or the send button. In uncontrolled mode the field clears afterwards (Figma Sending: "field cleared"). |
| `onStop` | `() => void` | — | Called when the Stop button is pressed while status="sending". |
| `onRetry` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Called with the kept text when Retry is pressed while status="error". |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `'Type your message here'` | Placeholder shown while the field is empty. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Message'` | Accessible name for the text field (there is no visible label). |
| `errorMessage` | `React.ReactNode` | `"Your message didn't send. Check your connection and try again."` | Inline message shown under the text when status="error". Rendered with the hello pc HelperString element (tone error) and wired to the field via aria-describedby. |
| `leadingActions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Leading toolbar slot. Defaults to the ghost "add" IconButton (wired to onAdd). Pass your own actions — e.g. an attachment button plus a tool picker — to replace it. |
| `onAdd` | `() => void` | — | Click handler for the plain "add" button. Only used when neither contextOptions nor onFilesSelected is set (otherwise + opens the context menu). |
| `contextOptions` | `AiContextOption[]` | — | Context types the + menu offers (Figma hellopc.ai.contextMenu). Setting this (or onFilesSelected) turns + into the context menu; pass AI_CONTEXT_OPTIONS for the spec's default list. |
| `contexts` | `string[]` | — | Controlled attached context values — each renders a Chip after +. |
| `defaultContexts` | `string[]` | `[]` | Uncontrolled initial context values. |
| `onContextsChange` | `(contexts: string[]) => void` | — | Called with the next attached context values. |
| `onFilesSelected` | `(files: File[]) => void` | — | Called with the files picked from File in the + menu. Add them to attachments (status uploading) and update as your upload progresses. |
| `accept` | `string` | — | accept for the file picker, e.g. ".pdf,image/*". |
| `attachments` | `AiAttachment[]` | — | Files shown above the text as AiFileAttachment tiles. Send stays disabled while any file is uploading. |
| `onRemoveAttachment` | `(id: string) => void` | — | Called with an attachment id when its × is pressed. |
| `onRetryAttachment` | `(id: string) => void` | — | Called with an attachment id when Retry is pressed on a failed upload. |
| `trailingActions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Trailing toolbar slot, rendered before the send button. Defaults to an uncontrolled voice AiModeToggle in the same segment; pass a controlled AiModeToggle (or null to remove it). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Content under the input card (outside the ring) — e.g. an AI disclaimer line. Not part of the current Figma spec; provided as a composition slot. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the field and every toolbar action. |
| `maxRows` | `number` | `6` | Maximum visible text lines before the field scrolls. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.FormHTMLAttributes<HTMLFormElement>, 'onSubmit' | 'onChange' | 'defaultValue'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<AiQueryInput onSubmit={send} />
<AiQueryInput segment="commercial" onSubmit={send} />
<AiQueryInput status="sending" onStop={cancel} />
<AiQueryInput status="error" value={draft} onValueChange={setDraft} onRetry={send} />
<AiQueryInput trailingActions={<AiModeToggle pressed={voice} onPressedChange={setVoice} />} />
<AiQueryInput contextOptions={AI_CONTEXT_OPTIONS} onFilesSelected={upload} attachments={files} onRemoveAttachment={remove} />
<AiQueryInput footer={<Disclaimer />} />
```

## Accessibility

- The field has no visible label, so it carries aria-label (label, default "Message").
- Every toolbar action is a real <button> with an accessible name; the send button's name follows its role — "Send message", "Stop response", "Retry".
- Error: the field gets aria-invalid and aria-describedby pointing at the message, which is announced via role="alert". The form is aria-busy while sending.
- The error is shown by the ring color and the icon + text message.
- Enter submits; Shift+Enter inserts a newline; IME composition is respected.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Match segment to the product audience | Mix segments on one screen |
| Keep the text on error so users can retry | Clear the draft when a send fails |
| Swap Send for Stop while a response streams | Disable the button during streaming — users need a way out |
| Put tools/attachments in leadingActions | Add more than one mode toggle without labels users can tell apart |
